Name: Once-lewis A Lewis Re-Texture into the Once-ler
Author: SiSAMAWiS
Description:
[size=6][b][u][color=#ff00ff][center]﻿ Once-ler Lewis[/center][/color][/u][/b][/size][color=#ff00ff]
[/color]
[size=3]Ever thought that Lewis just looked like the old Once-ler? If so this mod is for you :)

[/size]
[color=#0000ff]What it does[/color]

[list]
[*][size=3]Replaces Lewis with the Once-ler[/size]
[*][size=3]Replaces his Beach sprite with the Once-ler[/size]
[*][size=3]Replaces the Therapy Lewis with the Once-ler[/size]
[*][size=3]Replaces the Birthday to Spring 22 (earth day) which is the Once-ler's birthday[/size]
[*][size=3]Re-Names Lewis Once-ler[/size]
[/list]
[u][size=6][center]Compatibility[/center]
[/size][size=4]
[/size][/u][size=4]Please use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15012?tab=description]Coppersun's Lorax Mod[/url][/size]
[size=3]This Mod is incompatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544]Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion[/url]﻿, or any other mod that makes visual and/or dialogue changes to villagers I think. You must make it compatible for now (be sure to ask for permission first) and Credit me with the original.[/size]

[size=3]This Mod is compatible with mods such as [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239]NPCMapLocations[/url][size=3] and [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/229]Gift Taste Helper[/url][size=3]﻿.[/size]

[size=3]﻿Disclaimer: I did not replace the statue or the portraits YET[/size]
